description: High-explosive 81mm mortar cartridge, designed for use against personnel, bunkers, and light materiel targets.

variants.description: High-explosive 81mm mortar cartridge, designed for use against personnel, bunkers, and light materiel targets.  It uses a multi-option fuze.

description: High-explosive 81mm mortar cartridge, designed for use against personnel, bunkers, and light materiel targets.  This one uses an impact fuze.

variants.description: High-explosive 81mm mortar cartridge, designed for use against personnel, bunkers, and light materiel targets.  It is similar to the M821A2, but uses an impact fuze.
